name: Become a Lifeguard and Swim Instructor
org: City of Burnaby Parks, Recreation and Culture
what_you_do: Take Lifesaving Society courses with the City. They are Bronze Medallion, Bronze Cross, First Aid, then pool lifeguard and swim teacher. They prepare you to work at Burnaby pools.
who_can_apply: Age minimums by course. Bronze Medallion is 13 or older. You must swim 400 m in under 12 minutes. Bronze Cross is 13 or older. First Aid is 14 or older. Lifeguard and instructor courses are 15 or older.
pay_detail: Course fees not stated on the page read. The page says lifeguard jobs have great pay and flexible hours but gives no rate.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register for courses online or at a pool front desk.
how_to_apply: Check the age and skills table. Then sign up for courses with the City (WebReg). You can also ask at a rec center with an indoor pool. Email questions to the address on the page.
notes: The page says extra certificates help but are not required to be a lifeguard with the City. This covers the instructor and fitness leader certificates. Pay and job age rules are not stated. The page says courses can earn high school credits.
